name: realistic-maintainer-chat

messages.content: Assist with maintaining a Python API gateway. Preserve concrete requirements and failures.
For the desktop coding helper, keep Python 3.10 compatibility and avoid runtime dependencies.
The proxy should remain local by default and should never log API credentials.
The Windows CI job failed once because a test assumed POSIX path separators. Use pathlib in the test.
I will normalize the path assertion without changing production path handling.
Decision: Short duplicate outputs will remain unchanged; references are only useful when they actually reduce context.
Short duplicate outputs will remain unchanged; references are only useful when they actually reduce context.
The benchmark must contain realistic grep, pytest, and git diff output. Don't use generic phrases as needles.
I'll test exact error lines and unique user constraints, and the report will be generated from the checked-in fixtures.
Never claim cost savings without measuring actual provider usage and cache creation costs.
The cost table is illustrative only; actual provider usage and cache creation costs need separate measurement.
No secrets in logs. Never print Authorization, x-api-key, or the gateway token.
The regression suite should assert that credentials are removed before forwarding and are absent from errors.
Regression: test a usage event at the end of a larger stream.
The tee will keep a bounded rolling tail and still forward every chunk immediately.
For release notes, mention MIT licensing and the actual benchmark output, not the previous hard-coded numbers.
